comment: Single source of truth for the loomi palette. `prefix` is the brand prefix for the CSS custom property slots, exposed to consumers as `--<prefix>-<color>-<shade>` (defaults live in `--_<prefix>-<color>-<shade>-default`). `colors` is the finite set of overridable palette slots. `ramps` maps each color name onto a built-in Tailwind color ramp, which is the source of the *default* values. `shades` is the tonal scale every color provides. Change `prefix` here and rebuild to rebrand every custom property in one place.
